priority_policy: Implement EBS-SCM-020 and EBS-SCM-029 first; the first eight planning agents are follow-on candidates subject to fresh data and authorization validation.
readiness_note: S1 and S2 record historical local-source evidence, not current deployment readiness, entitlement, or acceptance. N records a feed gap. Re-profile every selected use case.
application_policy: Application-neutral definitions; new EBS Agent Blueprint Showcase ID unassigned; existing Planning App unchanged; Business Agent Workbench separate.
delivery_boundary: First implementation ends at verified local draft staging. Customer EBS integration is excluded.
